mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past 6 months signals rising inflation expectations, leading to higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or 5-day forward returns in high-inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% decline in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, leading to higher wages and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-unemployment periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) over the past 6 months signals rising supply-side pressures, leading to higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or 60-day forward returns in high-supply periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in the federal funds rate and a rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals a monetary policy mistake, leading to higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL rises > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or 20-day forward returns in policy mistake periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a demand-side driven expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 1% and UNRATE falls > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6% signals a labor market downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or 20-day forward returns in high-unemployment periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) and a rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals a supply-side driven contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 1% and CPIAUCSL rises > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
